description: This file defines the DebugControllerDispatcher class, which manages event listeners and methods for debugging control within the Playwright core server. It handles events like state changes, inspect requests, source updates, pause, and mode setting, and provides methods to initialize, set report states, recorder modes, highlight, hide highlights, resume, and kill the debug controller.

classes.name: DebugControllerDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for managing debug controller events and actions in the Playwright server.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the dispatcher with connection and debug controller, sets up event listeners.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the debug controller with given parameters.

methods.name: setReportStateChanged
methods.description: Sets the report state change status.

methods.name: setRecorderMode
methods.description: Sets the recorder mode for debugging.

methods.name: _onDispose
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners and disposes of the object.
